order.paidDescription_other: You have {{count}} tickets. They're below and in your email.

desk.title: Ticket desk
desk.setupDescription: Buyers pay through Stripe and get a QR ticket by email. The money goes straight to your club.
desk.settingsDescription: Change how many tickets you sell, or pause sales for a while.
desk.priceLocked: The price can't change once someone has bought a ticket.
desk.pauseHint: Hides the buy button until you turn sales back on.
desk.fees: Stripe keeps about 2.9% + 30¢ of each order. Wat2Do takes nothing.
desk.payoutsNeeded: Set up payouts first, so the money has somewhere to go.
desk.stopped: This event no longer sells tickets
desk.search: Search by name, email or code
desk.refundDescription: {{name}} gets {{amount}} back on their card, plus an email. Stripe doesn't return its fee to your club.
desk.declineDescription: {{name}} gets an email saying the club declined. Their ticket still works.
desk.cancelledDescription: Every ticket is refunded automatically. If some are still valid, Stripe was briefly unreachable: finish the rest here.

refund.promptDescription: Ask {{club}} for a refund. They decide, and you’ll get an email either way.
refund.signIn: Sign in to request a refund
refund.title: Ask {{club}} for a refund?
refund.description: If {{club}} agrees, the full price goes back to your card. You’ll get an email either way.
refund.notePlaceholder: For example: I can’t make the new date.
refund.pending: You asked {{club}} for a refund on {{date}}. You’ll get an email when they decide.
refund.declined: {{club}} declined your refund request on {{date}}. Your ticket still works.
